name: YouTube Plus
description: Import YouTube videos and associates them with taxonomy terms.
project_description:
The YouTube Plus (youtube_plus) module imports Youtube video information as nodes in order to create video list on your site. It also allows you to configure and import multiple YouTube channel's and playlist's which result in the possibility to segregate content.

 Provides a drush command to execute import/rollback contents by channel or in bulk. Also allows user to run it manually on the configuration page for each channel.

 Features 

 
 Each video is imported as a node with the available metadata 
 Each channel can be imported and managed separately 
 The configured channel's are created as a Taxonomy term and referenced in each node 
 The existing playlist's on the channel are created as a Taxonomy term and referenced in each node 
 
 Configuration 

 The configuration page can be found in admin/config/services/youtube_plus .

 
 Add an API Key in settings 
 Add an Channel in providing the channel ID 
 Select the channel and click "Import" 
 
 Note: You need to enable the Youtube Data API in your Google dashboard. You can follow this tutorial: Getting started 

 Data imported from YouTube 

 
 Title 
 Channel 
 Playlist 
 Video ID 
 Video URL 
 Medium Thumbnail URL 
 High Thumbnail URL
